text:
Zoe (Marketing): tiny ask for launch copy + webinar slides — can runtime run a 10k stratified rerun focused on tail latency and multilingual failure modes? Buckets: <32, 32-256, 256-1024, >1024. Langs: en, es, zh, ar, other. Variants: fp32 (rwd-7b-v1) and q4_0_v2 (rwd-7b-q4_0_v2). Need p50/p90/p99, token cost, failure rate per slice. Repro seed=2026. ETA Fri EOD?

Jordan (Runtime): yes. please confirm: include warm vs cold separation? and provide sample selector (SQL or list). Also want concurrency sweep (4/8/16)?

Zoe (Marketing): separate warm (warmup_tokens=3) and cold. attaching simple selector:

SELECT id, lang, token_count, payload FROM marketing_samples WHERE rand_seed=2026 AND lang IN ('en','es','zh','ar') ORDER BY rand() LIMIT 10000;

Include concurrency sweep 4/8/16. keep sequences >4096 capped to avoid long queue waits.

Priya (Eng): note: >1024 hits alternate kernel path; expect different perf. recommend logging kernel fallback counts and prompt-length CDF. Also suggest small extra run with zh warmup=8 if failures concentrate there.

Sam (Ops): scheduling low-priority job on staging 02:30 UTC tomorrow. example commands:
./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-v1 --quant=fp32 --samples=10000 --seed=2026 --buckets="<32,32-256,256-1024,>1024" --langs="en,es,zh,ar,other" --warmup_tokens=3 --concurrency=8 --batch=32
./run_bench --model=rwd-7b-q4_0_v2 --quant=q4_0 --...

runbot: Job queued -> job-20260305-077. ETA ~4.5h. logs: https://ci/internal/job-20260305-077/logs

Jordan (Runtime): implementation note: we'll tag warm requests with header X-Run-Warm=1. outputs will include: request_id, seed, lang, token_count, warm, latency_ms, token_cost, error_code, kernel_path. OK?

Zoe (Marketing): perfect. please upload per-slice CSVs + full traces to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4812345678/ and ping when ready.

runbot: job-20260305-077 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/marketing/4812345678/. short first-pass: q4_0_v2: better p50 on <32, slight regressions at >1024, overall failure rate 0.31% (most on zh long). full CSVs + plots in the bucket.

Zoe (Marketing): awesome, thanks everyone — will review and flag any follow-ups (likely zh resilience run). :raised_hands:
